exposure: mental health and substance use disorders (MSUD) at delivery hospitalization
clinical factors (e.g., length of stay at delivery)
cohort: The study included an estimated 2,697,605 weighted delivery hospitalizations of persons recorded in the 2019 Nationwide Readmissions Database from January to September.
finding: Persons with mental health and substance use disorders (MSUD) at delivery had significantly higher 90-day MSUD and non-MSUD readmission rates compared to those without MSUD at delivery.
